I’ve mapped the measured body joint angles back into the client’s normalized servo targets so the first control chunk can hold the starting pose rather than command the midpoint of each joint’s range. I’ll test that hold briefly and inspect the result.

steps.code:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Live control script for bookshelf_simple; preserves a real-robot style trace."""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+CAMERAS = ['left_eye_camera', 'right_eye_camera', 'room_camera']
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+layout = spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
+ranges = np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'], dtype=float)
+
+def pose_action(proprio, arm=None, hands=None):
+    """Convert desired measured radians for the 21 body actuators to normalized targets."""
+    a = np.zeros(61, dtype=np.float32)
+    # The proprio layout places the right arm after the left hand.
+    pidx = list(range(16)) + list(range(40, 45))
+    q = np.asarray(proprio, dtype=float)
+    for ai, pi in enumerate(pidx):
+        lo, hi = ranges[ai]
+        a[ai] = np.clip(2*(q[pi]-lo)/(hi-lo)-1, -1, 1)
+    if arm:
+        for name, rad in arm.items():
+            ai = layout.index(name)
+            lo, hi = ranges[ai]
+            a[ai] = np.clip(2*(rad-lo)/(hi-lo)-1, -1, 1)
+    if hands is not None:
+        a[21:] = np.asarray(hands, dtype=np.float32)
+    return a
+
+def save_result(res, tag):
+    res.save(str(OUT / tag))
+    print(tag, res.meta)
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    print('STATUS', r.status())
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video='frames')
+    save_result(obs, 'initial')
+    p = obs.meta['proprio']['now']
+    hold = pose_action(p)
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.repeat(hold[None, :], 10, axis=0),
+                   dt=spec['control_dt'], interpolate='hold', cameras=['room_camera'],
+                   video='frames', note='10-step measured-pose hold')
+    save_result(res, 'hold10')
+    print('STATUS', r.status())
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
